slides.title: TB-500 vs BPC-157: what's actually known
Evidence: mostly animals
slides.text: A thymosin beta-4 fragment. A 2024 study found TB-500 itself didn't speed healing — only its metabolite did. No controlled human trials.

slides.title: 3 small human studies
slides.text: A 2025 review: under 30 people in total, no control groups. The rest of the data is animal studies.
